 Rhode Island Board of Elections Encourages Use Of Secure Drop Boxes 
 By Community Submission 
 on 
 October 29, 2026 
 The Rhode Island Board of Elections is encouraging mail ballot voters who have not yet mailed their completed ballot to use one of the Board’s secure drop boxes located in all 39 cities and towns across the state. Voters can find secure drop box locations using this link: https://elections.ri.gov/elections/dropboxes/index.php . All mail ballots must be returned by 8 p.m. on Tuesday, Nov. 3. Completed mail ballots can also be dropped off at polling locations on November 3.
